description: Run compute, skip the IO manager write. Enable via run tag `dry_run=true`, env `DAGSTER_DRY_RUN=1`, or explicit `enabled: true` in YAML. Compute executes normally (side effects, timings, exceptions all observable); the returned value is discarded and asset yields a MaterializeResult(metadata={dry_run: true, elapsed_seconds, would_produce_bytes}) — no store_output call. Downstreams reading via IO manager get the previous non-dry-run value. Companion @dry_run decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Emits MaterializeResult only (no value written); AssetObservation tagged dry_run=true when dry-mode fires.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Explicit override; null (default) reads run tag `dry_run` then env `DAGSTER_DRY_RUN`.

name: Dry Run Asset
